articles.title: ‘Bhole Baba’ Shop Row in Agra: Viral Video Claims Debunked, Police Clarify Ownership
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Muslim youth running a shop in the name of ‘Bhole Baba’? The viral claim—and the truth behind it.”An alleged controversy over a shop operating under the name ‘Bhole Baba’ in Agra’s Belanganj area triggered an uproar on social media after a video went viral, claiming that a Muslim youth...

body.html:
A Muslim youth running a shop in the name of ‘Bhole Baba’? The viral claim—and the truth behind it.”An alleged controversy over a shop operating under the name ‘Bhole Baba’ in Agra’s Belanganj area triggered an uproar on social media after a video went viral, claiming that a Muslim youth was running the shop under a Hindu name. However, Agra Police have termed the claims misleading and issued a clarification after investigation.

According to the viral posts, a youth named Arif had put up a board reading ‘Bhole Baba’ at his shop. The issue reportedly escalated when a customer, while making a digital payment, saw a Muslim name appear on the QR code. The customer questioned Arif, following which an argument broke out. The incident was recorded on video and later shared on social media, along with a complaint being filed at the police station.

However, Agra Police said that the video, which is being circulated with misleading claims, is related to a chole-bhature shop named ‘Baba Chole Bhature’ located in the Belanganj area under Chhata police station limits. Upon verification at the spot, police found that the shop is owned by Vijay Shukla, not Arif.

Police further clarified that the video is around two to three months old and that Arif has been working at the shop as an employee for the past 15 years. According to the shop owner, the argument shown in the video was over payment for food with the person who recorded the clip, and it was later wrongly portrayed on social media. The claim that Arif is the shop owner was found to be false and baseless.

Agra Police said that accounts spreading the incident with misleading or incorrect facts are being identified and legal action is being taken against them. The police have appealed to citizens to verify facts before sharing content on social media, especially in sensitive matters that can disturb communal harmony.

articles.title: Hathras Anti-Encroachment Drive: Sadabad Nagar Panchayat EO Vikas Kumar Controversy

articles.excerpt: A shocking video from Hathras, Uttar Pradesh, has gone viral, sparking massive public outrage. During an anti-encroachment drive in Sadabad, Executive Officer (EO) Vikas Kumar was caught on camera using offensive language and openly threatening local street vendors.

body.html:
A shocking video from Hathras, Uttar Pradesh, has gone viral, sparking massive public outrage. During an anti-encroachment drive in Sadabad, Executive Officer (EO) Vikas Kumar was caught on camera using offensive language and openly threatening local street vendors.

The Incident: On Monday (12 January 2025), the Sadabad Nagar Panchayat and the Braj Bhoomi Expressway administration launched a joint operation to clear encroachments. When shopkeepers resisted, EO Vikas Kumar lost his temper, leading to a heated confrontation.

What was caught on camera: In the viral footage, the EO can be heard shouting: "We will beat you all up and drive you away from here... If you come in front of me, you'll be beaten up first." He further threatened to file government cases against anyone who obstructed the work.

Current Status: While the video is trending across social media, the Hathras District Administration and Nagar Panchayat have yet to issue an official statement regarding the officer's conduct.

articles.title: SHOCKING: Zepto Delivery Boy Assaulted in Delhi | What Happened to Risha Kumar? #breakingnews
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An 18-year-old Zepto delivery worker was allegedly assaulted and publicly humiliated at a Zepto store in East Delhi’s Old Kondli area after spraying perfume on himself.

body.html:
An 18-year-old Zepto delivery worker was allegedly assaulted and publicly humiliated at a Zepto store in East Delhi’s Old Kondli area after spraying perfume on himself. The incident took place on January 06, 2026, following which an FIR was registered at the New Ashok Nagar police station.

The victim has been identified as Risha Kumar, also reported as Rishabh Kumar, a resident of Harijan Basti near Ambedkar Park. According to his complaint, he entered the Zepto store and sprayed perfume taken from a shelf. The act was noticed by store employees, after which he was allegedly confined inside the premises.

Kumar alleged that the store staff forced him to squat “like a chicken” as punishment and then assaulted him. The entire incident was reportedly captured on the store’s CCTV cameras. He sustained injuries and was later sent for medical examination.

Police said an FIR was registered after a PCR call and the victim’s statement. CCTV footage is being examined, witness statements are being recorded, and the role of the store owner and other staff members is under investigation. Officials said strict action will be taken if the allegations are found to be true.

The incident has raised fresh concerns over the safety and treatment of gig workers. It comes amid recent reports of assaults on delivery riders in Delhi, including a road rage attack on a Zepto rider. Notably, gig workers across the country had staged protests on New Year’s Eve 2025, demanding better working conditions and protection.

articles.title: Female to Male Transformation: A Love Story Against All Odds | Naman & Anita's Journey
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: What would you sacrifice for true love? In a world full of boundaries, 25-year-old Naman (formerly Nenshu) from Ashoknagar, Madhya Pradesh, decided to break every wall of society to be with the person he loves. This is the incredible journey of Naman and Anita.

body.html:
What would you sacrifice for true love? In a world full of boundaries, 25-year-old Naman (formerly Nenshu) from Ashoknagar, Madhya Pradesh, decided to break every wall of society to be with the person he loves.

This is the incredible journey of Naman and Anita. Born as a girl, Naman always felt like a boy at heart. After meeting Anita on social media and falling in love, the two faced a massive challenge: how to be together in a conservative society?

From working odd jobs in Indore to saving ₹6 Lakhs for gender reassignment surgery in Delhi, their 3-year struggle is a testament to the power of true love. After 5 months of painful surgeries, Nenshu has finally become Naman, and today, they are living their dream life together.

The struggle of self-identity since childhood.
Meeting through social media and the bond between Assam and MP.
The financial and emotional battle to raise money for surgery.

articles.title: Argument Over Alcohol Leads to Brutal Murder of Mother and Wife in Parsa
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking double murder has rocked Parsa village after a man, identified as Sikandar Gupta, brutally killed his own mother and wife following an argument over his alcohol addiction.

body.html:
A shocking double murder has rocked Parsa village after a man, identified as Sikandar Gupta, brutally killed his own mother and wife following an argument over his alcohol addiction.

Full Report: In a gruesome incident, 30-year-old Sikandar Gupta allegedly murdered his mother, Runa Devi (60), and his wife, Priyanka (28), using a heavy iron pillar. According to local police, the incident occurred on Sunday night after Sikandar returned home in an intoxicated state.

Key Details of the Incident:

The Conflict: An argument broke out when Sikandar’s mother scolded him for his drinking habits.

The Crime: While the family slept, Sikandar used an iron mosquito net pillar to fatally strike both women.

The Arrest: Villagers alerted the police after finding Sikandar sitting outside the house. He was taken into custody immediately.

Investigation: C.O. Kundan Kumar Singh and a forensic team have inspected the scene and recovered the blood-stained weapon.

The incident has left the entire Parsa village in a state of shock and panic. Police are currently conducting a further investigation into the matter.

body.html:
A massive water pipeline burst in Gwalior’s Urban Green City has caused widespread destruction, flooding houses and cracking the ground open. Watch the terrifying CCTV footage of the moment the ground split apart.

Full Details: Late Saturday night, residents of Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, were woken up by a loud, blast-like sound. A major water pipeline running through the Urban Green City area burst under intense pressure. The force of the water was so strong that it cracked the ground open, leading to immediate flooding of the entire residential colony.

Key Highlights of the Incident:

CCTV Footage: Video shows the ground splitting in front of a residence before water gushes out.

Property Damage: Nearly a dozen houses have developed structural cracks; platforms and household items were washed away.

Resident Panic: Many families have evacuated their homes, fearing the weakened ground might lead to a total collapse.

Official Response: The Municipal Commissioner visited the site and ordered an immediate shutdown of the water supply line.

Local residents are now protesting against the "poor-quality" infrastructure, demanding accountability from the municipal authorities to prevent future disasters.

articles.title: "Death is Like a Water Bubble" | The Man Who Built His Own ₹12 Lakh Tomb in Telangana
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An 80-year-old farmer from Lakshmipuram, Telangana, has left behind a powerful message about dignity, responsibility, and the inevitable nature of death. Nakka Indraiah, who recently passed away, was laid to rest in the very tomb he built and maintained for himself while still alive.

body.html:
An 80-year-old farmer from Lakshmipuram, Telangana, has left behind a powerful message about dignity, responsibility, and the inevitable nature of death. Nakka Indraiah, who recently passed away, was laid to rest in the very tomb he built and maintained for himself while still alive.

A Life Prepared: Indraiah, a former Gulf NRI who rose from poverty to become a successful builder, spent nearly ₹12 lakh to construct a beautiful granite tomb on his farmland. His daily routine involved watering the plants around the site and sitting in quiet reflection, viewing the grave not as a symbol of sorrow, but as his "final home."

A Message of Love and Dignity: His primary wish was to be buried beside his late wife and to ensure his family would not face the burden of planning his funeral. Known for his philanthropy, he also built a school, a church, and the village entrance arch with his own earnings.

"Life is a water bubble and not permanent." Indraiah’s story has sparked a global conversation about how we view death and the legacy we leave behind. Watch the touching story of a man who conquered the fear of the end.

articles.title: Horror in Firozabad: Wife & Lover Kill Husband, Head Thrown in Borewell | Accused Shot in Encounter
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Firozabad police have solved a chilling murder case within 24 hours, involving a brutal decapitation and a love triangle gone wrong. The Case: On Sunday, the headless body of 26-year-old Saurabh Singh was found hidden in a tubewell chamber in Jakhai village, Narkhi.

body.html:
Firozabad police have solved a chilling murder case within 24 hours, involving a brutal decapitation and a love triangle gone wrong.

The Case: On Sunday, the headless body of 26-year-old Saurabh Singh was found hidden in a tubewell chamber in Jakhai village, Narkhi. Saurabh, an auto driver, had been missing for three days.

The Conspiracy: Investigations revealed that Saurabh's wife, Preeti, had been in an affair with a man named Suraj since 2022. Viewing Saurabh as an obstacle, Preeti plotted his murder. On Sunday night, she alerted Suraj when Saurabh went to sleep at the tubewell. Suraj and his friend Salman strangled Saurabh before using a sickle to decapitate him.

Police Action & Encounter: Acting on call details and locations, SSP Saurabh Dixit's team tracked the suspects. On Monday morning, during a police checking operation, the prime accused Suraj opened fire on the police. In retaliatory firing, Suraj was shot in the leg and arrested along with his accomplice Salman.

articles.title: Horror in Amroha: Court Employee Beaten to Death in Front of Wife & Kids | Road Rage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A minor traffic incident turned into a horrific tragedy in Uttar Pradesh's Amroha district, where a court employee was brutally beaten to death in a case of road rage.

body.html:
A minor traffic incident turned into a horrific tragedy in Uttar Pradesh's Amroha district, where a court employee was brutally beaten to death in a case of road rage.

The Incident: On Sunday afternoon (Jan 11), Rashid Hussain (38), a judicial employee, was traveling with his family near the Bambugarh–Joya bypass. A motorcycle overtook them from the wrong side and brushed against their car.

The Assault: Despite Rashid driving away to avoid conflict, the bikers chased him down near the Pathkoi Hussainpur culvert. In a shocking act of violence, the accused dragged Rashid out of his car and beat him to death while his wife and children pleaded for mercy.

Police Action: Amroha Police have registered a murder case against seven individuals, including main accused Kaleem, Shan, Qasim, and Naseem. Two suspects have been taken into custody. SP Amit Kumar Anand has formed four teams to catch the remaining absconders.
